 Taylor Ardrey USA TODAY Nov. 13, 2026, 1:16 p.m. ET Hear this story More than 720,000 vehicles are being recalled due to an issue that has prompted a fire risk warning.
 According to the recall safety report posted by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration , the issue in certain BMW vehicles is related to the water pump electrical connector.
 "Over time, due to material degradation at the connector, this could allow moisture to enter the pump and lead to the possibility of a short circuit," the document states. "This could increase the risk of a thermal event and, in rare cases, a fire."
 Here's what we know about the recall and what consumers should do next.
 Car recalls: Honda recalls over 635K vehicles. See the affected models Which models are affected?
 According to the NHTSA, 720,796 units are potentially affected. The models included are:
 2014-2016 BMW 228I
 2014-2016 BMW 228XI
 2012-2016 BMW 328I
 2012-2016 BMW 328XI
 2014-2016 BMW 428I
 2014-2016 BMW 428XI
 2012-2016 BMW 528I
 2012-2016 BMW 528XI
 2012-2015 BMW X1
 2013-2017 BMW X3
 2015-2018 BMW X4
 2016-2018 BMW X5
 2012-2016 BMW Z4
 The recall is connected to a previous recall, 24V608, the agency says, noting that vehicles repaired earlier must be remedied again.

 Car owners are advised to park their vehicles outside, away from any structures, due to the fire risk warning.
 The remedy for this issue is yet to be determined. Notification letters will be sent out in December.
 You can contact BMW at 1-800-525-7417.
